raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
- Drop finished requests from `running_batch` in `get_next_batch_to_run` on every step, after the `last_batch` merge, and reopen admission (`batch_is_full = False`) when that shrinks the batch. This replaces the prefill-only special case.
- Cause: under overlap, a prefill batch merges into `running_batch` before its result marks the requests that finish at prefill (`max_new_tokens=1`, or a stop on the first token). The only other cleanup, `update_running_batch`, runs on decode steps, which never come while chunked prefill keeps producing batches, so `#running-req`, `num_running_reqs`, and `/v1/loads` grow for the whole run.
- Add a CPU unit test that fails on main, and give two existing scheduler test fixtures the `batch_size` / `filter_batch` the new code reads.

Behavior change: finished requests now leave the running batch before admission on every step, so a workload whose running batch is full can admit a waiting request one step earlier than on main.

Fixes #43961; supersedes #43960.

raw_graphql_pull_request.title: [Fix] scheduler: Drop finished requests from the running batch before every admission

detail.body:
- Drop finished requests from `running_batch` in `get_next_batch_to_run` on every step, after the `last_batch` merge, and reopen admission (`batch_is_full = False`) when that shrinks the batch. This replaces the prefill-only special case.
- Cause: under overlap, a prefill batch merges into `running_batch` before its result marks the requests that finish at prefill (`max_new_tokens=1`, or a stop on the first token). The only other cleanup, `update_running_batch`, runs on decode steps, which never come while chunked prefill keeps producing batches, so `#running-req`, `num_running_reqs`, and `/v1/loads` grow for the whole run.
- Add a CPU unit test that fails on main, and give two existing scheduler test fixtures the `batch_size` / `filter_batch` the new code reads.

Behavior change: finished requests now leave the running batch before admission on every step, so a workload whose running batch is full can admit a waiting request one step earlier than on main.

Fixes #43961; supersedes #43960.

detail.title: [Fix] scheduler: Drop finished requests from the running batch before every admission

files.patch:
@@ -3847,15 +3847,12 @@ def get_next_batch_to_run(
                     # Merge running_batch with prefill batch
                     running_batch.merge_batch(last_batch)
 
-        # For prefill-only batch, filter out finished requests since they
-        # won't go through the decode step. This keeps running_batch accurate
-        # for load reporting (num_running_reqs via /v1/loads).
-        # Runs outside the last_batch block so stale requests are cleaned
-        # even when no new batches arrive (e.g. traffic stops).
-        if running_batch.is_prefill_only:
-            running_batch.filter_batch()
-            if running_batch.is_empty():
-                running_batch.batch_is_full = False
+        # Every step, not only after a merge: overlap merges a prefill's requests
+        # before its result finishes them, and update_running_batch may never run.
+        running_bs = running_batch.batch_size()
+        running_batch.filter_batch()
+        if running_batch.batch_size() < running_bs:
+            running_batch.batch_is_full = False
 
         if self.dllm_config is not None:
             new_batch = self.get_new_batch_dllm(running_batch)

@@ -73,6 +73,7 @@ def _scheduler_for_get_next_batch(*, tree_cache, chunked_req) -> Scheduler:
     s.server_args = MagicMock(speculative_skip_dp_mlp_sync=True)
     s.running_batch = MagicMock()
     s.running_batch.is_empty.return_value = True
+    s.running_batch.batch_size.return_value = 0
     s.running_batch.is_prefill_only = False
     s.running_batch.batch_is_full = False
     s.running_batch.reqs = []

@@ -35,7 +35,11 @@ def setUp(self):
         s.dp_attn_adapter = Mock()
         s.dp_attn_adapter.maybe_prepare_mlp_sync_batch.return_value = None
         self.running_batch = SimpleNamespace(
-            batch_is_full=False, is_prefill_only=False, is_empty=lambda: True
+            batch_is_full=False,
+            is_prefill_only=False,
+            is_empty=lambda: True,
+            batch_size=lambda: 0,
+            filter_batch=lambda: None,
         )
 
     def test_feature_gates(self):

@@ -0,0 +1,104 @@
+"""Finished requests leave the running batch before admission on every step (#43961)."""
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import Mock
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import maybe_stub_sgl_kernel
+
+maybe_stub_sgl_kernel()
+
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.utils import DisaggregationMode
+from sglang.srt.managers.schedule_batch import NextBatchPlan
+from sglang.srt.managers.scheduler import Scheduler
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=2, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class _Req:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.done = False
+
+    def finished(self):
+        return self.done
+
+
+class _Batch:
+    def __init__(self, reqs, extend, batch_is_full=False):
+        self.reqs = list(reqs)
+        self.forward_mode = SimpleNamespace(is_extend=lambda: extend)
+        self.chunked_req = None
+        self.is_prefill_only = False
+        self.batch_is_full = batch_is_full
+
+    def batch_size(self):
+        return len(self.reqs)
+
+    def is_empty(self):
+        return not self.reqs
+
+    def filter_batch(self, reqs_to_exclude=()):
+        self.reqs = [
+            r for r in self.reqs if not r.finished() and r not in reqs_to_exclude
+        ]
+
+    def merge_batch(self, other):
+        self.reqs.extend(other.reqs)
+
+
+class TestRunningBatchFinished(unittest.TestCase):
+    def _scheduler(self, seen):
+        s = Scheduler.__new__(Scheduler)
+        s.scheduler_stage_metrics = None
+        s.disaggregation_mode = DisaggregationMode.NULL
+        s.process_pending_chunked_abort = Mock()
+        s._process_hicache_events = Mock()
+        s.enable_fpm = False
+        s.dllm_config = None
+        s.chunked_req = None
+        s.enable_hisparse = False
+        s.require_mlp_sync = False
+        s._should_defer_prefill = Mock(return_value=False)
+        s.dp_attn_adapter = Mock()
+        s.dp_attn_adapter.maybe_prepare_mlp_sync_batch.side_effect = lambda b, **_: b
+        s.dp_attn_adapter.maybe_convert_decode_to_extend.side_effect = lambda b: b
+        s.update_running_batch = Mock(side_effect=lambda b: b)
+        s._arm_prefill_decode_interval = Mock()
+        s.ngram_embedding_manager = Mock()
+        s.ngram_embedding_manager.prepare_for_forward.side_effect = lambda b, **_: b
+
+        def get_new_batch_prefill(running_batch):
+            seen.append((list(running_batch.reqs), running_batch.batch_is_full))
+            # Chunked prefill keeps going: every step runs a prefill, never a decode.
+            prefill = _Batch([], extend=True)
+            return NextBatchPlan(batch_to_run=prefill, running_batch=running_batch)
+
+        s.get_new_batch_prefill = get_new_batch_prefill
+        return s
+
+    def test_request_finished_at_prefill_leaves_before_next_admission(self):
+        seen = []
+        s = self._scheduler(seen)
+        live, short = _Req(), _Req()
+        running = _Batch([live], extend=False, batch_is_full=True)
+
+        # Overlap: the prefill that runs `short` merges before its result
+        # marks `short` finished.
+        plan = s.get_next_batch_to_run(
+            running_batch=running, last_batch=_Batch([short], extend=True)
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(seen[-1], ([live, short], True))
+
+        short.done = True
+        s.get_next_batch_to_run(
+            running_batch=plan.running_batch, last_batch=plan.batch_to_run
+        )
+        reqs, batch_is_full = seen[-1]
+        self.assertEqual(reqs, [live])
+        self.assertFalse(batch_is_full)
+        s.update_running_batch.assert_not_called()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
